# Apps gallery repair

Retention: retained as bounded before/after review evidence for #4621. Replace only with superseding reviewed evidence.

Before: hosted Gallery run [42209735580](https://github.com/kontourai/station/actions/runs/42209735580), PR head `2f651f44488ff883d575fc36c4bcfd803cc7bf89`, artifact `13498644919`. Its product assertion step reported 10 tile-name mismatches and 24 undersized mobile sidebar targets.

After: canonical eight-scene capture at functional source `49457eb38295a459df642aa09f327b056b62a9a0`, 23.9 seconds. All eight candidate PNGs were opened at 390/1440 in both themes. The unchanged standard product audit reported **0 findings / 0 not allowlisted**. Named GET fixtures supply generic Boards and preview state; these pictures do not qualify provider, installed/native, physical-device or release behavior. The two capture environments differ in operating system, emoji rendering and session background state.

The scoped pixel command refused to report success: all eight scenes are new to the tracked baseline, so there were zero actual comparisons. No pixel baseline or findings allowlist was changed. These retained before/after images support visual inspection, not a formal pixel-comparison pass or a full 109-scene qualification.
